title: Power Wiring - Color Codes
description: Color codes used in power wiring for 120/240 Volt and 277/480 Volt systems

components.content:
## Typical Power Wiring Color Codes

### 120/240 Volt

| Wire Type | Color | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| Phase 1 | Black | Power |
| Phase 2 | Red | Power |
| Phase 3 | Blue | Power |
| Neutral | White or 3 white stripes | Return path |
| Ground | Green | Safety ground |

### 277/480 Volt

| Wire Type | Color | Purpose |
|-----------|-------|----------|
| Phase 1 | Brown | Power |
| Phase 2 | Orange | Power |
| Phase 3 | Yellow | Power |
| Neutral | Gray or 2 white stripes | Return path |
| Ground | Green with yellow stripe | Safety ground |
